items.mainDefect: RuleActionsButtons.V2 now lets `rule` be undefined, but it still always calls `useRulerRuleAbility(rule, ...)`, and that hook's parameter was not widened to accept `undefined`.

secondary.defect: `getEditableIdentifier` returns undefined when the rule is neither a RulerRule nor a Grafana prom rule, so the whole actions block (edit button and More menu) silently returns null with no feedback to the user.
